case.summary: Customer C07297 reported transaction 3476682 for $482.12 as unauthorized. The flagged transaction was an online purchase on 2016-11-21 at 20:30:00 using a device marked new to the account. Within 48 hours, four online transactions totalling $1906.07 were processed, with the flagged transaction being more than four times the cardholder's median transaction amount of $58.98 across 261 prior transactions. Prior closed cases matching the card-not-present-new-device pattern in the same region showed 8 confirmed fraud cases and 0 false alarms. The assessment fraud probability reached 0.85, driven by the pattern of multiple unusual-sized card-not-present transactions on a new device. I conclude this is fraud with high confidence and recommend immediate card block.

sar.narrative: Customer C07297 reported that a $482.12 online purchase on card C07297-K1 on November 21, 2016 at 20:30 was unauthorized. The transaction used a device profile (Trident/7.0, Windows 7, IE 11.0, 1920x1080) marked as new to the account. The flagged transaction was one of four online purchases totaling $1906.07 made on this card within a 30-minute window on November 21, 2016, between 20:00 and 20:30. All four transactions were conducted online for product code C billing in region 264.0. The cardholder's transaction history from July 2016 through December 2016 shows 261 transactions across 37 billing regions with a median amount of $58.98, making the flagged transaction and its three companions substantially larger than typical purchase behavior. The $482.12 transaction alone is more than four times the cardholder's median transaction amount. The pattern of multiple large online transactions from a new device within a compressed timeframe matches the card-not-present fraud typology, and case memory returned eight structurally similar prior cases from the same region and pattern, all eight of which were confirmed as fraud. The internal fraud assessment reached a probability of 0.85 with a confirmed fraud verdict. The total suspicious amount in this episode is $1906.07. The bank has blocked the card, created a case record, and filed this suspicious activity report.
